why: Every identity ring takes the counter-rotation, including the shipped solid ring with no marker: invisible on screen, since a circle cannot show rotation, which is exactly why only a read of the written angle can see it. It is the control for the spin case's second assertion, which `identity-ring-spin-guard-inverted` never reaches because the case stops at its first failure.
killedBy: player identity: ring and shell tint holds the `shape` marker still as the hull turns, and leaves the solid ring unturned (issue #1023)
